title: Zero-click visibility
content: Zero-click visibility is brand exposure inside a search result or an AI answer that the reader sees without clicking through to a website.

meta.why: A 2024 SparkToro study found that a majority of Google searches in the United States ended without a click to the open web, which means traffic reports miss part of how often your brand is seen.
meta.example: An AI answer names a company as an option for payroll software, and the reader moves on without visiting the company's site.
meta.check: Track brand mentions and citations in sampled answers alongside visits, and report the two measures as separate numbers.
meta.limitation: A sampled answer shows that a brand appeared for that prompt and does not show how many people saw the answer.
meta.sources: SparkToro: 2024 zero-click search study | https://sparktoro.com/blog/2024-zero-click-search-study-for-every-1000-us-google-searches-only-374-clicks-go-to-the-open-web-in-the-eu-its-360/ | Industry study
